title: Tine NDE 940
content: First I heard and saw nothing anymore, then I seemed to be looking from the top of the room at my own body. I saw the doctors and the nurses fighting for my life. I heard what they said and I saw myself. I had a warm feeling and then I entered a tunnel. At the end of the tunnel was a bright warm white vibrating light it was beautiful and it gave me a very calm and reassuring feeling. I wanted to go to the light and I floated towards it. The warm feeling became more and more pleasant as I came closer to the light. Suddenly I felt again the pain of the accident, I was furious that the doctors had brought me back.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes AccidentHeart attack Clinical death I had a cardiac arrest and they had to reanimate me.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was at the top of the room and could see my own body.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: I heard what they said in the operating room and in the tunnel I heard a reassuring humming noise.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes A long tunnel with a white and vibrating light at the end.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes A white, warm, vibrating light.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm The tunnel I think.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Conservative/fundamentalist geen enkele godsdienst spreekt me aan , ik geloof in niets
elements.What is your religion now?: Conservative/fundamentalist ik geloof nog steeds in niets
